name: Boon of the Binding: Mind
summary: Intelligence +2 (max 24), given when Kehlenn is bound. No price.

source.note: chapter 24: +2 to one ability when the ritual binds Kehlenn (the Moonfall variant; level 14 only comes from the Horned King's bargain). Our words.

benefit.text: Adela's power rolls through you as the binding takes. Your Intelligence score increases by 2, to a maximum of 24.

cost.text: None. This one was freely given.
